TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: transaction transaction to obtain a price rule by your id
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: 1. Input and validations: reads pricingRuleId from the request. If pricingRuleId is not null and is less than 0, it logs an error, adds advice ABKO00000050 and sets severity WARN. 2. Decisions and branches: after the negative-id validation, the flow continues without an early return. If the library response is null, it logs an error, adds advice ABKO00000040 and sets severity WARN. 3. Libraries and methods invoked: invokes ABKOR000.executeGetPricingRuleById(pricingRuleId) to query the pricing rule by id. 4. Errors and actions after them: ABKO00000050 is raised for a negative pricingRuleId, and ABKO00000040 is raised when no pricing rule is found for the requested id. 5. Outputs and assignment conditions: assigns pricingRule with the DTO returned by the library; when the library returns null, pricingRule is assigned as null.

Accessed Libraries.Description: Queries the pricing rule identified by pricingRuleId and maps the database result to the response DTO.

Error Management.Description of the error situation: Invalid parameter: pricingRuleId must be non-negative.

Input Parameters.Description: Identifies the pricing rule to retrieve by id.

Output Parameters.Description: Returns the pricing rule DTO obtained from ABKOR000.executeGetPricingRuleById without additional transformation in the transaction.
